target.shots: Keep recorded shots and labels; no division by 1024 or fabricated shot normalization.

split.grouping: Retain full-corpus exact-QASM/workflow/model-input transitive components, reassign within selected panel without reading targets.

methods.label: Ma-Li 51-feature logical-recipe graph adaptation
methods.input: Existing logical_inputs 51 raw globals + 178-node DAG; nominal-index T1/T2

methods.label: Ma-Li matched 51-feature global MLP
methods.input: Same 51 globals, fit/validation/test rows and objective as graph

methods.label: Qonductor code-faithful feature polynomial, common-panel adaptation
methods.override: Replace old corpus and splits with common_panel only; preserve pinned upstream counter/column order, transformations and inner candidate grid.
methods.input: Pinned compiled/submitted views; upstream field swap counts CX/CZ/ECR, not literal SWAP

methods.label: QCRE snapshot critical-path adaptation
methods.input: Pinned compiled/submitted circuit and nominal durations

methods.label: Qiskit scheduled-duration reference
methods.input: Same pinned compiled/submitted circuit and nominal durations

methods.label: Hyb-HANAS effective-cost adaptation
methods.input: Fixed compiled circuit, frozen nominal calibration
methods.policy: Preserve declared r2 log-domain formula; invalid probabilities/missing inputs/overflow yield unavailable. Kyoto composite is a separately labeled paired sensitivity, never selected by test error.

methods.label: Scholten nominal throughput adaptation
methods.policy: Use all nine pinned backend entries, including Kyoto/Osaka; record throughput definition per row. No CLOPS conversion/imputation. Generic wire depth is not QV-normalized effective depth.

calibration.affine: OLS y=a+b*x on successful outer-train only
calibration.policy: Raw and calibrated variants have distinct output clocks and labels; preserve failed raw inputs; transformations, normalization and tuning never use outer-test.

neural_profile.policy: New logical cells start from seed; port batch optimization mechanism and run CUDA numerical/memory canary on actual logical graphs before freezing batch_profile.json. Never reuse compiled-run optimizer state or infer graph capacity from VRAM alone.

comparison.paired: Publish row-ID hash and n for each pair and the all-method intersection; coverage is always against 7350. Do not rank MAE computed on different rows.
comparison.seed_reduction: Median per-row OOF prediction across all three seeds; retain individual-seed metrics and dispersion. Missing seed blocks final aggregate.
comparison.bootstrap: 10000 paired group bootstrap replicates, seed42, resample frozen group IDs; report observed point difference separately from bootstrap mean and 95% percentile interval.
comparison.reconstruction_sensitivity: Filter the same OOF predictions to exclude 2835 unverified candidates, leaving4515 rows; no claim of4515 exact historical circuits because archive230 and QPack3945 are qualified reconstructions.

before_fit: finite positive labels and recorded shots or explicit missingness
gates.fold0: Graph and MLP each three seeds, polynomial one cell; QA targets, masks, train-only normalization, finite predictions and checkpoint metadata before folds1-4. Poor score alone is not a failed gate.
gates.scientific_review: S5 reviews implementation and fold0 evidence; no score-driven feature/split change.

historical_results: Retain as separate evidence. Raw analytical values may be reused only with exact method/input hashes; calibrated predictions must be refit on new panel outer-train.
claim: Retrospective exploratory common-panel comparison after prior benchmark inspection; cohort selected by logical-feature availability. Generalization claims concern this panel and its reconstruction assumptions, not all QPU workloads.
routine_queue: C1 adapters, input availability and CUDA canaries
C2 analytical raw projection and new fold calibrations
C6 paired aggregation and reconstruction sensitivity
C7 semantic tables and reproducibility documentation
